configure_rl_algorithm: configure the RL training parser to use ppo, a2c, acktr, ucb, or mixreg algorithms
set_optimization_hyperparameters: set learning rate, gamma discount, gae lambda, and entropy coefficient for the RL parser
configure_plr_replay: configure the priority level replay buffer strategy, score transform, and sampling probability
configure_accel_level_editor: configure the ACCEL level editor mutation probability, method, and paired regret estimate
set_environment_args: set the environment name, test environments, and CarRacing-specific arguments like frame stacking and grayscale
